title: Ultherapy vs HIFU: Differences and Prices
h1: Ultherapy vs HIFU: which non-surgical lift should you choose?
desc: Ultherapy vs HIFU (Ultraformer III) compared: technology, imaging, comfort, results, how long each lasts and prices in Dubai at Skin & Laser.
answer: Both Ultherapy and HIFU (Ultraformer III) use focused ultrasound to lift and tighten skin by stimulating collagen. Ultherapy adds real-time ultrasound imaging so energy is placed precisely, and costs more: AED 7,000 + VAT for the face versus AED 5,000 + VAT with Ultraformer III. Both take one session with results over 2 to 3 months.
facts: Ultherapy AED 7,000 + VAT; HIFU AED 5,000 + VAT
Ultherapy AED 10,000 + VAT; HIFU AED 10,000 + VAT
body:
## The main difference: seeing under the skin

Ultherapy shows the skin's layers on a screen during treatment, so the practitioner can confirm the depth before each line of energy. Ultraformer III delivers energy at fixed depths using interchangeable cartridges, which is faster and more affordable.

## Which to choose

- Ultherapy: thinner or more complex areas, the brow and neck, or when you want the most precise single treatment
- Ultraformer III HIFU: face, jawline and body areas, maintenance, or when budget matters
- Either: early jowling, soft jawline, mild neck laxity

## Comfort and recovery

Both feel like deep, short bursts of heat. Neither needs recovery time, and both can cause mild redness or tenderness for a few days.
prices: HIFU Ultraformer III face or neck
HIFU Ultraformer III face and neck
